name: Party role
description: What an organization does in a procurement process, following OCDS. One organization can hold several roles in one process. That's why roles belong to the party, not to wherever it shows up.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Procuring entity
hasDefinedTerm.description: The organization running the process. Not always the same as the buyer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Tenderer
hasDefinedTerm.description: Submitted a bid. Publishing every tenderer, not just the winner, is what lets people check that a competition was fair.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Funder
hasDefinedTerm.description: Provided the money, often a different level of government or a donor.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Review body
hasDefinedTerm.description: Handles complaints and challenges to the process.
